acceptanceCriteria: A ticket whose current workState is a hold does not count against the planner selection window; it is reported with a distinct deferral reason, not SELECTED.
Tickets that are actionable are selected up to the window as before; the decision is deterministic for a given snapshot and workState observation.
When workState is unavailable or UNKNOWN, behaviour is unchanged (fail closed, no silent widening).
Maintained tests reproduce the starvation (held tickets filling the window) and show the actionable ticket selected after the fix.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#624 (orchestrator triage; reporter observations on main-2fff511, not reproduced yet).

Tickets the program's workState reports as held (hold-lane, hold-dep) are SELECTED by the planner and fill `maxActiveAttempts`; 142 tickets were DEFERRED LIMIT_EXCEEDED, including one waiting for review for hours. Workaround was native executionPrerequisites on 110 tickets.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#632, merged to main as 265835f77f9aca1175dfeac06ee7e63ecf17a805. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0853-workstate-held-window.md at that commit (the digest is that file's sha256), which records the change, the maintained tests the acceptance criteria name, the independent Codex review and its repairs. The batch head passed the doc gates, go vet, the full suites of the touched packages on darwin and every hosted CI check (go-product shards, doc-gates, go-interop). NOT_RUN: make gate, live multi-agent/dispatcher qualification and non-darwin execution where that entry says so.

title: corvint-tasks plan: tickets held by the program's workState still occupy the maxActiveAttempts selection window, starving others with LIMIT_EXCEEDED (issue #624)
